title: Need and Aid Calculator
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: See how cost of attendance, the Student Aid Index, and a college's aid package combine into demonstrated need, net price, and unmet need.

learningObjectives: Students will calculate demonstrated need, net price, and unmet need from a cost of attendance, Student Aid Index, and aid package, and compare outcomes at colleges with different aid policies.

keyQuestions: Why isn't the Student Aid Index the amount your family will pay?
Why can a college with a higher sticker price end up cheaper?
What does a "meets full need" policy promise, and what doesn't it promise?
commonMisconceptions: The SAI is the bill your family will receive.
Loans reduce the price of college.
assessmentOpportunities: Students calculate demonstrated need, net price, and unmet need for a new set of numbers and match the calculator.
